calibrationLifecycle: Current accepted readout/Rabi adapter receipts + matching actual parameters -> immutable calibration.json with calibrationVersion -> frozen native paired schedule with source hash and ideal recovery/timing audit -> new acquisition -> native paired bootstrap estimate -> controller independently verifies before publishing.
publicationApi: F8Adapter.publish_calibration(validationSnapshot) -> registered JSON artifact. After sq_rb independent verification passes, append its passed select/verify operation IDs and ruleVersion to acceptedEvidence. Verifies both complete 62-raw-record suites, disjoint data, different seed schedules and unchanged actual parameters, then writes immutable data/calibrations/Qxx_<calibrationVersion>.json. No hardware or parameter-registry mutation.
acceptance: gate_fidelity is omitted if model/seed-bootstrap publication checks fail; controller owns numerical quality gates and independent second suite. No old TRIAL calibration is silently upgraded.
cancellation: Same F8Adapter.execute cancel callable; row-boundary stop requested, forced termination returns unknown. reconcile never reacquires.
limits: Conditional IRB model estimate; confidence intervals exclude unknown systematics and drift; pre/post contrast does not prove stationarity. No fixed primitive-count conversion. No real hardware was used to implement/test this adapter.
